title: GridAI button no longer covers rows
problem: On a computer the floating GridAI button hid a row's buttons and part of cards.
now: The button is a small round icon that shows its name on hover, and every page keeps room at its end.
steps: Open Marketing › Offers on a computer
Scroll to the end and check the last row is clear
Hover the round button to see GridAI
notes: Where: Every page with the GridAI button (e.g. Marketing › Offers)

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
